The '''Hakks''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] clan on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They once destroyed the last [[Shrook Clan|Shrook]] outpost on Gamorr, a rival clan led by [[Grruna Thu]]. The latter hired [[Reog's Regiment]], a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], to crush the Hakks in retaliation. The mercenaries were ultimately overwhelmed in the battle.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
